executor_check_results.command: $out=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'chapman-admin-api-startup.out.log'; $err=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'chapman-admin-api-startup.err.log'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $out,$err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $p=Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList 'app.js' -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err; try { $deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(45); $ok=$false; do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:8080/' -TimeoutSec 3; if([int]$r.StatusCode -lt 500){ $ok=$true; break } } catch { if($p.HasExited){ break } } } while((Get-Date) -lt $deadline); if(-not $ok){ Write-Output 'STDOUT:'; if(Test-Path $out){ Get-Content -LiteralPath $out }; Write-Output 'STDERR:'; if(Test-Path $err){ Get-Content -LiteralPath $err }; exit 1 } } finally { if($p -and -not $p.HasExited){ Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } }
